baseline.label: Baseline
baseline.description: Use clear everyday language with enough context to understand the answer.

brief.label: Brief
brief.description: Give the answer and essential details with minimal wording.

decision.label: Decision
decision.description: Say what a change means and what it costs, so someone who is not reading the code can decide.

guided.label: Guided
guided.description: Explain unfamiliar work step by step and define necessary terms.

professional.label: Professional
professional.description: Use concise, precise, and neutral workplace language.
